messages:
jordan: FYI canary slice in us-west climbed p95 ~4.1% above baseline; deploy-bot flagged it.

deploy-bot: [alert] Canary policy breach: p95 > +4% for 3 windows. Recommended: pause canary.

maria: grabbing graphs now https://grafana.internal/d/xyz ; saw pod restarts on gw02 around 12:36.

sam: errors stable, tail latency only. could be sidecar oom or node pressure.

jordan: pausing canary advance and pinning rollout. maria, can you check sidecar memory and recent infra events?

maria: confirmed OOMKill on gateway sidecar at 12:36. Autoscaler bounced a node.

ops_lead: Given infra cause, prefer region-scoped actions. Options: 1) restart sidecar and retry canary, 2) regional rollback of model-server, 3) keep pinned and investigate. Avoid global revert unless hit.

sam: prepping revert command just in case: `rdwctl deploy revert --region us-west --component model-server --to rdx-3b@v2026-04-10 --reason "canary p95 regression"`

jordan: plan: restart sidecar in us-west, hold 10m, run 10% us-west probe. If p95 remains >+3% then execute regional rollback. I'll own exec.

release_manager: If we do regional revert, want a 1-line customer blurb and internal release-note entry (impact, scope, owner). Ill draft.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback suppressed for 30m per human hold. Partial traffic-split reverts require human confirmation to widen scope.

maria: sidecar restart issued: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway-sidecar -n us-west` on gw02/gw03. Watching.

jordan: monitoring. If green at 12:55, we resume rollout; if not, we revert regionally and ping #customer-ops + legal/comms.

sam: note: pin dedicated env to avoid impacting reserved customers: `rdwctl pin-version --env dedicated --model rdx-3b@v2026-04-15`

jordan: noted. updating runbook and will post final decision here and in #customer-ops. :thumbsup:
